cultureItems.title: Chhath Puja
cultureItems.subtitle: The Grand Sun Festival
cultureItems.description: The most revered festival of Bihar, Chhath Puja is a four-day celebration dedicated to the Sun God. Devotees gather at riverbanks at sunrise and sunset to offer prayers, creating a mesmerizing spectacle of devotion and color. The festival involves rigorous fasting, ritual bathing, and offering of fruits and sweets.

cultureItems.title: Folk Dance & Music
cultureItems.subtitle: Living Traditions
cultureItems.description: Kaimur is alive with the sounds of Birha, Jhumar, and Sohar — traditional folk forms that narrate tales of love, valor, and harvest. Local performers in vibrant costumes bring these art forms to life at every festival. The Birha genre, in particular, is known for its soulful melodies and poetic storytelling.

cultureItems.title: Traditional Handicrafts
cultureItems.subtitle: Artisan Heritage
cultureItems.description: Skilled artisans of Kaimur craft beautiful pottery, bamboo baskets, and handwoven textiles. These crafts, passed down through generations, reflect the region's deep connection with nature and its artistic heritage. Madhubani-influenced paintings and terracotta work are also popular among visitors.
